Fonts from @fontsource/allerta-stencil, @fontsource/saira-stencil-one and @fontsource/stardos-stencil version 5.3.0 (Latin, 400 normal), embedded as WOFF base64 in quick/fonts.js. Each original font is licensed under SIL OFL; licenses are kept alongside this file. No font outlines have been modified.

OpenType parsing: opentype.js 1.3.4, vendor/opentype.js. Original dist/opentype.module.js with the final export list replaced by `export const parseFont = parseBuffer;`, the unused source-map reference removed, and trailing whitespace stripped. MIT licenses in vendor/LICENSE-opentype.txt, including the bundled tiny-inflate 1.0.3 and codepointat 0.2.0 polyfill.
